header.title: Badges & Rewards
header.description: Define the achievement badges learners can unlock on the gamified dashboard. Pick what each badge is named, how it looks, and the condition that unlocks it.

enableCard.label: Enable Badges & Leaderboard
enableCard.description: Master switch. When off, badges and the course leaderboard are hidden everywhere — across the learner app and the admin Learning Reports leaderboard tab.

unsavedBanner.text: You have unsaved changes. Don't forget to save.

disabledBanner.after: for this institute. Turn the switch on to configure badges, points and the leaderboard.

scoring.title: Points & Scoring
scoring.description: How many points each action is worth. These drive the learner's points & level and the course leaderboard ranking. Set a factor to 0 to ignore it.

leaderboardNames.title: Show full names on leaderboards
leaderboardNames.description: By default leaderboards show learners as anonymized initials (e.g. "A.G."). Turn this on to show full names on both the shareable public link and the in-app leaderboard learners see. Each learner's own row always reads "You".

libraryArt.title: Show ready-made artwork instead of plain icons
libraryArt.description: Give every badge a polished tiered look, matched to what unlocks it. You can still fine-tune any badge from the library.

emptyState.text: No badges configured. Add one to get started.

iconHint.default: Pick an icon, choose from the library, or upload your own.

badgeCard.descriptionPlaceholder: Shown on hover, e.g. Maintain a 7-day streak
badgeCard.manualHint: No automatic condition — staff award this badge from a learner's profile or the students list.
badgeCard.hiddenHelp: Learners don't see this badge until they earn it. Applies on updated learner apps.

toasts.resetRemovesManual_one: {{count}} staff-awarded badge will be removed from the catalogue when you save. Awards already given stay on learner records.
toasts.resetRemovesManual_other: {{count}} staff-awarded badges will be removed from the catalogue when you save. Awards already given stay on learner records.
toasts.saveGuardFailed: Couldn't check the current badges on the server — nothing was saved. Try again.

manual.label: Awarded manually by staff
manual.help: Never unlocks on its own — a teacher or admin awards it to a learner (e.g. Helping Hand, Most Improved). Each learner can hold a badge once; for recurring recognition create dated or tiered variants.

course_count.label: Courses enrolled
course_count.help: Unlocks when the learner is enrolled in at least this many courses.

slide_count.label: Slides available
slide_count.help: Unlocks when this many slides are available to the learner.

streak.label: Daily streak
streak.help: Unlocks at this many consecutive active days.

xp_total.label: Total XP earned
xp_total.help: Unlocks when total XP reaches this value.

course_completion.label: Course completion %
course_completion.help: Unlocks when any course reaches this completion percentage.

assessment_score.label: Assessment score %
assessment_score.help: Unlocks when the best released assessment score reaches this percentage.

live_session_count.label: Live classes attended
live_session_count.help: Unlocks after the learner attends this many live classes (in total).

live_session_streak.label: Live class streak (in a row)
live_session_streak.help: Unlocks after the learner attends this many live classes in a row, without missing one.
